cloudflare-pages: Praised for a generous free tier and very fast static hosting; some find Next.js hosting troublesome.
cloudflare-registrar: Loved for at-cost domain pricing with no renewal markups; a few find support slow or absent.
cloudways: Praised for responsive chat support and easy server management; many find small plans slow.
dreamhost: Praised for reliable shared and VPS hosting with helpful support; some find managed WordPress slow.
dynadot: Liked for a simple interface, fair pricing and easy transfers; few real complaints.
fastmail: Praised as reliable, fast and easy, with human support; a few find the calendar clunky.
fly-io: Liked as easy to deploy to and cheap; some find databases and linked services hands-on.
flywheel: Praised for helpful support and an easy dashboard for WordPress; some want more features.
hetzner-server-auction: Loved for dedicated servers at very low prices; some dislike price increases on existing servers.
hosting-com: Praised for helpful support and steady uptime; many dislike renewal price increases.
inmotion-hosting: Praised as reliable with helpful, easy-to-reach support; a couple report steep renewal increases.
ionos-vps: Liked as very cheap and stable; some find price increases and hard-to-cancel contracts.
kinsta: Praised for excellent, fast support, speed and reliability; many find the cost and resource limits steep.
linode: Valued for reliability, good support and simple pricing; some cite a major outage in mid 2025.
namesilo: Liked for pricing and free WHOIS privacy after years of use; some find support poor.
netcup: Praised for strong performance at low prices; many find support and account handling slow.
oracle-cloud: Valued for a generous free tier and stable small servers; some find free instances hard to keep.
porkbun: Liked for low, predictable renewal prices and an easy interface; a minority find support slow.
pressable: Praised as rock solid for WordPress with supportive staff; one customer found it poor.
racknerd: Valued as very good-value budget VPS with reliable uptime; a few report slow speeds or outages.
rocket-net: Praised for fast load times and quick access to real support; some find the cost high.
spaceship: Liked as a cheap, simple, trouble-free registrar with friendly refunds; a few had bad support.
vultr: Praised for reliable, fast VPS performance and quick support; some report suspensions or lockouts.
zoho-mail: Valued as cheap, trouble-free custom-domain email with a useful free plan; a few find setup complicated.
